<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="UTF-8"/><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"/><title>Tiny Left Unsupervised | Illustrated Stage 6</title>
<style>
:root{color-scheme:dark;--gold:#f4c57e;--pink:#ee74ac;--deep:#211228;--cream:#fff5df;--mint:#a8ffdc;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif}*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;margin:0;background:#0c0911;touch-action:manipulation}body{display:grid;place-items:center}button{font:inherit;cursor:pointer;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #aaffea;outline-offset:2px}.hidden{display:none!important}
#game{position:relative;width:min(100vw,177.7778dvh);height:min(100dvh,56.25vw);aspect-ratio:16/9;overflow:hidden;border:clamp(2px,.35vw,5px) solid #c59270;border-radius:clamp(10px,1.5vw,21px);box-shadow:0 0 38px #000;color:#fff1d9;background:#261429}#game:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;border:2px solid #ffdfb433;pointer-events:none;z-index:70;border-radius:inherit}
#hud{position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto;height:10%;background:#26152fe9;border-bottom:2px solid #dcaa75b3;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 1%;gap:.65%;z-index:30;white-space:nowrap;font-weight:850}#brand{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(9px,1.31vw,21px);color:var(--gold);margin-right:.5%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:27%}.pill{background:#4b2b43c9;border:2px solid #bf8d9b;border-radius:14px;padding:3px 7px;font-size:clamp(9px,1.05vw,17px)}#energyWrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-left:.5%;font-size:clamp(9px,1.18vw,17px)}#energyTrack{width:clamp(28px,10vw,140px);height:clamp(5px,1vw,14px);border:1px solid #dba38b;border-radius:12px;background:#120b16;overflow:hidden}#energyFill{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ee6ca4,#ffe4ae);width:35%;transition:width .2s}.spacer{flex:1}.icon{height:75%;min-width:4%;min-height:20px;border:2px solid #9f809f;color:#fff;border-radius:11px;background:#3c2947;font-size:clamp(12px,1.8vw,24px);padding:0 1%;line-height:1}
#scene{position:absolute;top:10%;left:0;right:0;bottom:24%;background-image:linear-gradient(#1b101322,#190b1833),url(data:image/webp;base64,);background-position:center center;background-size:cover;overflow:hidden}#sceneTitle{position:absolute;top:1.7%;left:1.4%;z-index:16;border:1px solid #f4c77a;background:#291632d9;border-radius:20px;padding:.6% 1.6%;font-family:Georgia,serif;color:#ffe1a7;font-size:clamp(9px,1.3vw,18px);font-weight:900;text-shadow:0 2px #221017}
#stats{position:absolute;z-index:17;top:2%;left:37%;right:13%;height:12%;min-height:20px;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:space-around;gap:3px;background:#28182adf;border:2px solid #e4b883;border-radius:12px;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(9px,1.3vw,17px)}#stats strong{color:#fbe4b9}#scene.cleaning #stats{display:flex}
#tiny,#partner{position:absolute;z-index:6;bottom:-4%;object-fit:contain;object-position:bottom;filter:drop-shadow(0 5px 9px #22111d99);pointer-events:none;transition:transform .3s,opacity .3s}#tiny{left:3.5%;width:23%;height:76%;object-position:bottom left}#partner{right:4%;width:19%;height:76%;object-position:bottom right}#scene.cleaning #tiny,#scene.cleaning #partner{display:none}#partner.noosh{width:23%;height:92%;right:2%;bottom:-11%}#partner.mo{width:21%;height:75%}#scene.endphase #tiny{left:7%;width:24%}#scene.endphase #partner{right:4%;width:22%;height:82%}
#speech{position:absolute;z-index:18;top:13%;left:26%;width:49%;max-height:40%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:2px;color:#302035;background:var(--cream);border:3px solid #4e2947;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 5px 0 #32192e9a;line-height:1.14;text-align:center;padding:.7% 2.5%;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(10px,1.23vw,18px);overflow:visible}#speechName{font-size:.82em;color:#a04e75;letter-spacing:.05em;font-weight:950}#speech.right{left:24%;width:48%}#speech.left{left:27%;width:48%}
#evidenceLayer,#stainsLayer{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:10;pointer-events:none}#evidenceLayer>* ,#stainsLayer>*{pointer-events:auto}.clue{position:absolute;width:clamp(30px,4.2vw,59px);height:clamp(27px,4.4vw,62px);display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0;background:none;border:0;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 3px #130b10) drop-shadow(0 0 2px #ffe4b5);cursor:pointer;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(var(--rot,0deg));transition:transform .14s,opacity .32s;touch-action:manipulation}.clue svg{width:84%;height:84%;overflow:visible}.clue:active{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.3) rotate(var(--rot,0deg))}.clue.found{opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translate(-50%,-60%) scale(1.6)}.clue.hinted{animation:hintGlow .5s 5;outline:2px dashed #e1ff8d;border-radius:50%}.clue .mark{position:absolute;bottom:-12%;color:#ffe8a5;font-size:10px;opacity:0}.clue.hinted .mark{opacity:1}@keyframes hintGlow{50%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px #ffff65)}}
.stain{position:absolute;width:clamp(38px,5.3vw,72px);height:clamp(30px,4.5vw,62px);display:grid;place-items:center;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:none;border:0;padding:0;cursor:pointer;touch-action:none;user-select:none;z-index:12}.stain .dirt{position:absolute;inset:14% 9%;border-radius:52% 44% 49% 40%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 42% 37%,#572731d0,#b24e5ca8 42%,#451b2975 68%,transparent 78%);box-shadow:9px -6px 0 -9px #6b2b45a8,-8px 5px 0 -7px #e49a93ad;opacity:calc(.88 - (var(--scrub,0) * .008));transform:rotate(var(--spin,0deg)) scale(calc(1 - var(--scrub,0) * .006));pointer-events:none}.stain.blue .dirt{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 39% 42%,#00bdebbf,#3b82d1a6 45%,#00397a82 64%,transparent 77%)}.stain.gold .dirt{background:radial-gradient(ellipse,#d3a346c4,#7a3c277d 51%,transparent 76%)}.stain.wet .dirt{filter:brightness(1.18) saturate(1.2)}.stain.wet:after{content:'💧✨';position:absolute;top:-28%;font-size:clamp(12px,1.7vw,22px);animation:float 1s infinite alternate;pointer-events:none}.stain .scrubMeter{position:absolute;bottom:-23%;height:8%;width:90%;background:#1b1326bb;border:1px solid #fcdda9;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;opacity:0}.stain.wet .scrubMeter{opacity:1}.stain .scrubMeter i{height:100%;width:calc(var(--scrub,0)*1%);display:block;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#7aefc0,#fff0bc)}.stain.done{opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .45s}.stain:active{filter:brightness(1.3)}@keyframes float{to{transform:translateY(-5px)}}
#secret{position:absolute;z-index:10;left:84.6%;top:35%;width:clamp(15px,1.8vw,29px);height:clamp(15px,1.8vw,29px);background:transparent;border:0;color:#ffdc88;transform:rotate(17deg);text-shadow:0 0 6px #ffffa9;font-size:clamp(12px,1.8vw,27px);opacity:.4;cursor:pointer}#secret.revealed{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
#flash{position:absolute;z-index:20;left:35%;top:38%;width:30%;padding:1% 2%;background:#202034e0;border:2px solid var(--gold);border-radius:12px;text-align:center;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(10px,1.5vw,23px);pointer-events:none;animation:flash .85s ease-out forwards}@keyframes flash{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px) scale(.9)}16%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1.05)}78%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-14px)}}
#patience{position:absolute;top:3%;right:2%;width:24%;height:12%;display:none;align-items:center;gap:3%;padding:1%;background:#2f1b30df;border:1px solid #e0ab8b;border-radius:12px;font-size:clamp(9px,1.1vw,15px);font-weight:900;z-index:16}#patience .meter{height:25%;flex:1;background:#1b1124;border-radius:15px;border:1px solid #ffce96}#patience .meter i{display:block;height:100%;width:60%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#ec7298,#e4cc7a,#75ebbc);border-radius:15px}#scene.interrogation #patience{display:flex}
#bottom{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:24%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:34% 66%;padding:1.2% 1.4%;background:linear-gradient(#321a37f8,#211327);border-top:4px solid #f1c18c;z-index:25;gap:1%}#copy{overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:1px}#kicker{font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#f6b5d4;font-size:clamp(9px,1.08vw,14px)}#heading{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-weight:900;color:#ffe1a3;font-size:clamp(16px,2vw,30px);line-height:1.05}#story{font-size:clamp(10px,1.06vw,17px);line-height:1.17;font-weight:600;max-height:45%;overflow:hidden}#actions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:1.2%;flex-wrap:wrap;overflow:hidden;padding:0 1% 0 0}#actions .btn{flex:1;min-width:0;max-width:100%;min-height:50%;height:auto;padding:1.2% .7%;border:3px solid #ffdda1;box-shadow:0 5px 0 #6a2d51;border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(#ffdf94,#c8904d);color:#3b2132;font-size:clamp(10px,1.15vw,18px);font-weight:950;line-height:1.12;white-space:normal}#actions .btn.magenta{background:linear-gradient(#ec78aa,#9a366e);color:#fff5e2}#actions .btn.teal{background:linear-gradient(#82e4c8,#258d87);color:#102a34}#actions .btn.selected{outline:3px solid #c3ffde;box-shadow:0 0 11px #c6ffe8,0 5px 0 #4a6a75}#actions .btn:disabled{opacity:.45}#actions .btn:active{transform:translateY(2px);box-shadow:none}#actions.three .btn{font-size:clamp(9px,1.08vw,17px)}#scene.cleaning~#bottom #actions .btn{font-size:clamp(9px,.98vw,15px);padding:.8% .5%}#actions.two .btn{max-width:46%}
#tracker{position:absolute;bottom:24.5%;right:1%;z-index:19;display:none;align-items:center;gap:8px;border-radius:10px;padding:4px 9px;background:#241628de;color:#ffe7c4;font-size:clamp(9px,.95vw,14px);font-weight:800;border:1px solid #ca9e77;max-width:98%;white-space:nowrap}#tracker span.done{color:#9fffd4;text-decoration:line-through}#scene.cleaning ~ #tracker{display:flex}
#modal{position:absolute;z-index:60;top:13%;left:20%;width:60%;max-height:75%;overflow:auto;border:3px solid #f8ce88;border-radius:17px;box-shadow:0 10px 45px #07040de0;background:#2d1935fa;text-align:center;padding:2.2%;color:#fff5df}#modal h2{font-family:Georgia,serif;color:#ffdea5;margin:0 0 .5em;font-size:clamp(17px,2.4vw,30px)}#modal p{font-size:clamp(10px,1.35vw,20px);line-height:1.3;margin:.55em auto}#modal .btn{background:linear-gradient(#ffdf95,#c8904d);border:2px solid #ffe5b4;border-radius:12px;padding:1% 3%;font-weight:950;color:#301b31;font-size:clamp(12px,1.4vw,20px);margin:1%}
#archives{position:absolute;z-index:55;inset:10% 4% 24%;background:#27172cf7;border:3px solid #ffcb89;border-radius:15px;overflow:auto;padding:2%;text-align:center}#archives h2{margin:0 0 .5em;font-family:Georgia,serif;color:#ffddaa;font-size:clamp(16px,2.1vw,30px)}#archives p{font-size:clamp(10px,1.12vw,17px)}#archives .grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:1%;margin:2% 0}#archives .ending{border:1px solid #b98d93;border-radius:8px;padding:3%;font-size:clamp(9px,.93vw,15px);background:#3c253e}#archives button{padding:1% 5%;border:2px solid #ffcb89;background:#d4a765;border-radius:12px;font-weight:900;color:#311c32}
@media(max-width:850px){#brand{max-width:25%}#sceneTitle{top:2%;max-width:34%;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}#speech{top:16%;padding:1.1% 2%;max-height:42%}#bottom{grid-template-columns:34% 66%;padding:.8% 1%}#heading{font-size:clamp(14px,2vw,19px)}#story{font-size:clamp(9px,1.17vw,12px)}#actions .btn{border-width:2px;border-radius:11px;min-height:54%;padding:1.3% .4%;box-shadow:0 3px 0 #6a2d51}#tracker{gap:4px;padding:2px 6px}#stats{left:39%;right:9%}}
@media(max-height:460px){#speech{top:14%}#tiny{height:74%}#partner{height:75%}#scene.cleaning #tracker{bottom:24.5%}#modal{top:12%;max-height:77%}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*:before,*:after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}}

/* Stage 6 interactive clean-up: visually explicit deposits and evidence targets */
#destinationLayer{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:12;pointer-events:none}#stainsLayer{z-index:16}#evidenceLayer{z-index:14}
#destinationLayer .stash{pointer-events:auto;position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:clamp(49px,8.4vw,130px);height:clamp(40px,7.4vw,100px);border:2px solid #ffe5acb8;border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#332036d9,#20112fd4);color:#fff6df;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:0;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 4px 10px #170913a8;touch-action:manipulation;transition:transform .12s,box-shadow .2s,border-color .2s}
#destinationLayer .stash .stashIcon{font-size:clamp(21px,3.3vw,44px);line-height:1}
#destinationLayer .stash .stashLabel{font-weight:950;font-size:clamp(8px,.95vw,14px);letter-spacing:.05em}
#destinationLayer .stash.active{border:3px solid #9ffbd2;box-shadow:0 0 13px #88efba,0 3px 8px #1b1128;animation:stashPulse .8s infinite alternate}
#destinationLayer .stash:active{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(.95)}
@keyframes stashPulse{to{box-shadow:0 0 22px #b9ffe6,0 5px 10px #1b1128}}
#destinationLayer.hidden{display:none}
.clue{z-index:15}.clue.selected{outline:3px dashed #a8ffe7;border-radius:50%;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 9px #b3f6d3);transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.23)}
#tracker span.selected{background:#226954;color:#fff8c9;border:1px solid #bfffe2}
.stain{z-index:14;width:clamp(58px,10.5vw,160px);height:clamp(42px,7vw,102px);}
.stain .dirt{inset:4%;opacity:calc(1 - (var(--scrub,0)*.01));box-shadow:none;transform:rotate(var(--spin,0deg)) scale(calc(1 - var(--scrub,0)*.006));}
.stain.wetarm{width:clamp(50px,6vw,98px);height:clamp(38px,5vw,75px)}
.stain.wetarm .dirt{border-radius:25% 65% 40% 50%;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 60% 25%,#fff2d8 0 9%,transparent 24%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 40% 35%,#ffceccf5,#de728fb8 35%,#8a3e658f 61%,transparent 75%);filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 3px #320d3b)}
.stain.wetarm .dirt:after{content:'💧';position:absolute;right:10%;bottom:-33%;font-size:clamp(15px,2.5vw,30px)}
.stain.pawprints{width:clamp(92px,17vw,246px);height:clamp(40px,8.2vw,117px)}
.stain.pawprints .dirt{inset:0;border-radius:0;background:none!important;transform:rotate(-11deg) scale(calc(1 - var(--scrub,0)*.006));opacity:calc(1 - (var(--scrub,0)*.01));filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 1px #32160c80)}
.stain.pawprints .dirt svg{display:block;width:100%;height:100%}
.stain.confetti .dirt{inset:7% 0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 18% 31%,#ffe447 0 3%,transparent 5%),radial-gradient(circle at 37% 62%,#e878d3 0 4%,transparent 6%),radial-gradient(circle at 74% 45%,#1bd6e6 0 3%,transparent 5%),radial-gradient(circle at 57% 12%,#fbd06a 0 3%,transparent 5%),linear-gradient(20deg,transparent 8%,#b45f3a 33%,#ca7c5b6b 50%,transparent 78%);border-radius:48%}
.stain.pawprints.wet:after{content:'🧹';top:-38%}
.stain .scrubMeter{bottom:-8%;height:10%;width:84%}
#mopAnim{position:absolute;z-index:21;pointer-events:none;font-size:clamp(16px,2.5vw,32px);transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(-25deg);filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 3px #2b1127)}
#sceneTitle{pointer-events:none}
@media(max-width:850px){#destinationLayer .stash{width:clamp(37px,8vw,70px);height:clamp(29px,7vw,58px);border-radius:7px}#destinationLayer .stash .stashIcon{font-size:clamp(16px,3.3vw,27px)}#destinationLayer .stash .stashLabel{font-size:clamp(7px,.9vw,10px)}.stain.pawprints{width:clamp(72px,16vw,140px)}.stain.wetarm{width:clamp(36px,6vw,60px)}}

/* v3: art-first clean-up scene, no floating destination cards */
#scene.cleaning{background-position:center 59%;}
#scene.cleaning #tiny{display:block!important;left:12%;width:18%;height:64%;bottom:-3%;z-index:7;opacity:.97;filter:drop-shadow(0 5px 10px #25091680)}
#scene.cleaning #partner{display:none!important}
#scene.cleaning #sceneTitle{font-size:clamp(10px,1.25vw,19px);padding:.35% 1%;background:#2d1726df;max-width:34%}
#scene.cleaning #stats{top:1.3%;left:40%;right:4.3%;height:10%;background:#2a1726e3;border-color:#d7a774aa;pointer-events:none}
#roomDecor{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;display:none;z-index:8}
#scene.cleaning #roomDecor{display:block}
#roomDecor .room-bin{position:absolute;left:1.4%;bottom:0%;width:11%;height:35%;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 5px #28110f) drop-shadow(0 0 4px #ffbb5988)}
#roomDecor .room-bin svg,#roomDecor .room-bin img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}
#roomDecor #seatTracks{position:absolute;z-index:1;left:41.8%;top:51%;width:19%;height:12%;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 2px #230e08);opacity:.72;transition:opacity .55s;pointer-events:none}
#roomDecor #seatTracks.clean{opacity:0}
#roomDecor #seatTracks svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
#destinationLayer{z-index:12}
#destinationLayer .stash,#destinationLayer .stash:active{border:none!important;background:transparent!important;box-shadow:none!important;display:block;position:absolute;overflow:visible;opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)!important;touch-action:manipulation;min-height:0;min-width:0;padding:0;filter:none;animation:none}
#destinationLayer .stash[data-dest="book"]{width:21%;height:54%;}
#destinationLayer .stash[data-dest="bin"]{width:11%;height:27%;}
#destinationLayer .stash[data-dest="box"]{width:14%;height:38%;}
#destinationLayer .stash[data-dest="rug"]{width:52%;height:20%;}
#destinationLayer .stash .stashIcon{display:none}
#destinationLayer .stash .hotspotTrace{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;fill:none;stroke:#ffe2a5;stroke-width:6;stroke-linejoin:round;opacity:.29;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 3px #ffc568);transition:opacity .18s,stroke .15s,filter .15s;pointer-events:none}
#destinationLayer .stash[data-dest="rug"] .hotspotTrace{stroke-width:12;opacity:.68}
#destinationLayer .stash .stashLabel{position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:100%;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:2px 7px;background:#352035d9;border:1px solid #eaca91;border-radius:6px;color:#fff0d1;font-size:clamp(9px,1vw,14px);letter-spacing:0;white-space:nowrap;opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s;pointer-events:none;text-shadow:0 1px 2px #1b0e20}
#destinationLayer .stash.active .hotspotTrace,#destinationLayer .stash.hinted .hotspotTrace{stroke:#acffe0;opacity:1;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 4px #a4ffe8) drop-shadow(0 0 8px #8bffbf);animation:environmentGlow 1.2s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
#destinationLayer .stash.active .stashLabel,#destinationLayer .stash.hinted .stashLabel{opacity:1}
@keyframes environmentGlow{to{opacity:.6;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 7px #bdffe9) drop-shadow(0 0 13px #b3ffd8)}}
#scene.cleaning.placing .stain{pointer-events:none}
.stain{filter:none!important}
.stain .dirt{inset:0!important;background:none!important;border-radius:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;transform:scale(calc(1 - var(--scrub,0) * .002))!important;opacity:calc(1 - var(--scrub,0) * .01)!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 2px #2c180d7d)!important;display:block}
.stain .dirt svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;overflow:visible}
.stain.wetarm{width:clamp(40px,5.8vw,85px)!important;height:clamp(35px,5vw,70px)!important}
.stain.pawprints{width:clamp(150px,34vw,450px)!important;height:clamp(42px,7vw,100px)!important}
.stain.confetti{width:clamp(125px,23vw,315px)!important;height:clamp(38px,6vw,84px)!important}
.stain.wet:after{content:'✦';color:#b7ffe5;top:-10%;right:8%;font-size:clamp(13px,2vw,22px)}
.stain.pawprints.wet:after{content:none}
.stain .scrubMeter{bottom:-9%;height:9%;width:62%;border-color:#a9f5d0}
#scene.cleaning[data-tool="mop"] .stain.pawprints:not(.done) .dirt{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 7px #c9f7b2)!important}
#scene.cleaning[data-tool="spray"] .stain.wetarm:not(.done) .dirt,
#scene.cleaning[data-tool="spray"] .stain.confetti:not(.done) .dirt,
#scene.cleaning[data-tool="wipe"] .stain.wet:not(.done) .dirt{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px #d6fff5)!important}
#scene.cleaning #secret{z-index:17;left:90.5%;top:24%} .stain.wetarm .dirt:after{content:none!important}#stainsLayer .stain.done{pointer-events:none!important}
#scene.cleaning #tracker{max-width:45%;right:0;white-space:nowrap;}
